{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing or invalid values in customer_age
print("Unique values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].unique())
print("Count of -1 (invalid age):", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the data type of revenue
print("Data type of revenue:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print("Any non-numeric revenue values after conversion?", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print("Customer age summary:", sales_df['customer_age'].describe())"}
